clauses.requirement: Hazard warning signal (UN R48 para 6.6): a flashing closed-circuit tell-tale shall be provided and is mandatory.

Hazard warning signal other requirements: shall comply with the requirements specified in paragraph 6.5.9; if a power-driven vehicle is equipped to draw a trailer, the hazard warning signal control shall also be capable of bringing the trailer's direction-indicator lamps into action; the hazard warning signal shall be able to function even if the device which starts or stops the propulsion system is in a position which makes it impossible to start the propulsion system.
Stop lamp: the individual specifications of paragraph 6.7 of UN R48 (presence, number, arrangement) shall be met by the stop lamp function of the rear lamp.

Stop lamp presence: devices of S1 or S2 categories are mandatory on all categories of vehicles; devices of S3 or S4 category are mandatory on M1 and N1 vehicles, except chassis-cabs and N1 vehicles with open cargo space, and optional on other vehicle categories.

Stop lamp number: two S1 or S2 category devices and one S3 or S4 category device shall be fitted on all categories of vehicles; the devices shall be type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.

Except where a category S3 or S4 device is installed, two optional category S1 or S2 devices may be installed on vehicles of categories M2, M3, N2, N3, O2, O3 and O4 (additional to the two S1 or S2 devices required under 6.7.2).

Only when the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle is not located on a fixed body panel but separates one or two movable parts (e.g. doors) and lacks sufficient space for a single S3 or S4 device on the median longitudinal plane above such movable parts, either two S3 or S4 category type "D" devices may be installed; or one S3 or S4 device may be installed offset to the left or right of the median longitudinal plane; or an interdependent lamp system of category S3 or S4 may be installed.
Stop lamp arrangement: no special requirement applies to the arrangement of the stop lamp.
